description: Recall past memory to avoid re-optimizing recently-touched articles and to learn what worked.

**If recall exits non-zero** (3 = Ollama unavailable, 2 = network/auth): do NOT mark task done. Set status to `blocked`, post error as comment. Without history we'd risk re-optimizing the same articles repeatedly.
If recall succeeds, post the output as a comment. Identify:
- Articles optimized in last 30 days (DON'T re-optimize unless 14+ days passed since last edit)
- **Yesterday's memory ID** (will update its outcome tomorrow based on observed metrics movement)
- Optimization patterns that worked (e.g., 'CTA in meta moved CTR by Y%')
Set task to done (only if recall succeeded).
